LanguageData.HE_Start_Nord.label: Heirs of Nordheim
LanguageData.HE_Start_Nord.description: Five people of Nordheim raise a new longhouse on cold land. They start with the Nordheim heritage, warm furs, a hunting bow, a spear and a bundle of saga staves.
LanguageData.HE_Start_Nord.scenario.summary: Five Nordheim settlers raise a longhouse. Nordheim heritage.
